description: Two releases in event mode: release ids travel in the chunks, symbol sets stay unbound, chunk ids are content-addressed and stable. From the supported CLI floor on, a new release re-uploads only chunks whose bytes changed for another reason: webpack's runtime chunk spells the lazy chunk name by concatenation, which the CLI does not strip; rollup and vite emit a literal import, which it does. Older plugins re-upload differently: @posthog/rollup-plugin 1.6.0 injects before Vite 8's Oxc minifier rewrites the snippet, so every chunk re-uploads; @posthog/webpack-plugin 1.7.0 let the CLI inject on disk, so none does.
